definitions.explanation: Standard first-person plural pronoun. Polite enough for most situations: classroom, workplace, and public-facing speech. Inclusive when the listener is part of the group; otherwise refers to the speaker and others.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧です。
⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{私|わたし}たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{誇|ほこ}り→誇り：03623_hokori⟧だ。

⟦{今度|こんど}→今度：01327_kondo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧、{私|わたし}たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧です。
examples.english: We're planning to travel to Kyoto this coming weekend.

notes:
Standard plural of ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧ (I). Politeness-neutral and safe in nearly any context. Choice of first-person plural depends on speaker register and group composition.

FIRST-PERSON PLURALS:
- {私|わたし}たち: we (standard, neutral)
- {私|わたくし}たち: we (very formal)
- {僕|ぼく}たち / ⟦{僕|ぼく}ら→僕ら：22784_bokura⟧: we (masculine, casual to neutral)
- ⟦{俺|おれ}→俺：02185_ore⟧たち / ⟦{俺|おれ}→俺：02185_ore⟧ら: we (masculine, casual/rough)
- ⟦うちら→うちら：30645_uchira⟧: we (feminine, casual)
- ⟦{我々|われわれ}→我々：03795_wareware⟧: we (formal speeches, in-group identity)

USAGE:
- INCLUSIVE: includes the listener when context allows ({私|わたし}たち⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}めよう→決める：00858_kimeru⟧ Let's decide together).
- EXCLUSIVE: excludes the listener in most narrative contexts ({私|わたし}たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きました→行く：00119_iku⟧ We went to a movie yesterday).

COMMON PATTERNS:
The possessive is {私|わたし}たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (our). たち can attach to other personal nouns to mean 'and others' (⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧たち the teachers).
